question: ABCD is a rhombus such that ∠ACB = 50°. The value of ∠ADB is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

AC bisects ∠C ⇒ ∠C = 2×50° = 100°

⇒ Adjacent ∠D = 180° − 100° = 80°

⇒ BD bisects ∠D

⇒ ∠ADB = 80° ÷ 2 = 40°

**∴ Answer = 40°**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

ABCD is a rhombus

∠ACB = 50°

**Concept Used:**

Diagonals bisect angles, adjacent angles supplementary

 
 
• 
• A D C B 50° 

**Calculation:**

⇒ AC bisects ∠C ⇒ ∠C = 2 × 50° = 100°

⇒ ∠D = 180° − 100° = 80°

⇒ BD bisects ∠D

⇒ ∠ADB = 80° ÷ 2 = 40°

**∴ ∠ADB = 40°**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Rhombus:** All sides equal

**Diagonal Property:** Diagonals bisect vertex angles

**Angle Sum:** Adjacent angles = 180°

**Tip:** Always label vertices in diagram for clarity
